topPRs.title: feat: Osaki Sepolia L1 + L2 ProxyAdmin owner transfers (097, 098)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Two stacked tasks that move the **Osaki Sepolia** (chainId `9111973`) chain
ownership from the standard Sepolia L1PAO Safe to the new owner Safe
`0xFB0F8937A0d6999C67E8a01310eBf7fe1859205F` (and its L1-to-L2 alias on L2).

- **`097-osaki-l1-ownership-transfers`** — `TransferOwners` template
  - `ProxyAdmin.transferOwnership(0xFB0F...)`
  - `DisputeGameFactoryProxy.transferOwnership(0xFB0F...)`
  - `DelayedWETH` (v1.5.0) is post-U16 / not ownable → the template logs a
    "not ownable, not performing transfer" line and produces no state change.
- **`098-osaki-l2pao-transfer`** — `TransferL2PAOFromL1` template
  - `OptimismPortal.depositTransaction` targeting the L2 ProxyAdmin predeploy
    (`0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000018`) with
    `transferOwnership(alias(0xFB0F...))`.
  - Aliased L2 owner: `0x0C208937a0D6999c67E8A01310ebF7fE18593170`.
  - Stacked after `097`. A `stateOverride` pre-applies the L1 transfer so the
    template's `proxyAdmin.owner() == newOwnerToAlias` check passes when
    simulating in isolation.

Osaki is not in the public `superchain-registry`; both tasks use
`fallbackAddressesJsonPath` with chain addresses sourced from `op-deployer`
state. The chain reuses OP Sepolia's standard `SuperchainConfig`
(`0xC2Be75506d5724086DEB7245bd260Cc9753911Be`), so
`TransferOwners._validateSuperchainConfig` is satisfied.

The L1PAO is a 2-of-2 nested Safe (FoundationUpgradeSafe + SecurityCouncil).
All three Safe nonces are pinned via `stateOverrides` so the domain/message
hashes in each `VALIDATION.md` are reproducible — signers must re-verify the
live nonces with `cast call <safe> "nonce()"` before signing and bump the
overrides + re-simulate if anything has advanced.

## Test plan

Both tasks simulate cleanly on Sepolia:

- [x] `just simulate foundation` for 097 and 098 produces the hashes recorded
      in each `VALIDATION.md`.
- [x] `just simulate council` for 097 and 098 produces the hashes recorded in
      each `VALIDATION.md`.
- [x] `just simulate-stack sep 097-osaki-l1-ownership-transfers <foundation|council>`
      passes the TaskManager hash check.
- [x] `just simulate-stack sep 098-osaki-l2pao-transfer <foundation|council>`
      passes the TaskManager hash check (stack: 097 → 098).
- [x] Observed L1 state diff for 097: ProxyAdmin slot `0x00` and
      DisputeGameFactoryProxy slot `0x33` flip from the old to the new owner.
- [x] Observed L1 state diff for 098: OptimismPortalProxy params slot bump
      with `_gasLimit = 0x30d40 (200,000)`; L2 effect is verified post-
      execution per the manual steps in `098/VALIDATION.md`.

## Pre-signing checklist (for reviewers)

- [ ] Confirm `0xFB0F...205F` is the intended new owner (verified on-chain as
      a 1-of-12 Gnosis Safe v1.4.1).
- [ ] Confirm DGF + ProxyAdmin should be transferred together (DelayedWETH is
      non-ownable and skipped automatically).
- [ ] Re-verify the three live Safe nonces against `cast call <safe> "nonce()"`
      and update the `stateOverrides` + re-simulate if any have advanced
      since the values pinned in `config.toml`.

topPRs.title: docs: add AGENTS.md AI agent guidance
topPRs.author: sebastianst
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds a root-level `AGENTS.md` with AI-agent (and human) guidance for working in
this repo, focused on the safety constraints around governance operations.

This is part of an ongoing migration of AI guidance out of an internal tooling
plugin and into the repos it applies to, so the guidance lives as committed,
reviewable docs alongside the code it governs.

## What was migrated

Governance/task guidance previously held in the internal plugin has been
distilled into a single self-contained `AGENTS.md`. It captures:

- What this repo is (tasks, templates, validation files, simulation) and its
  layout (`src/tasks/eth`, `src/tasks/sep`, `src/template`, etc.).
- The non-negotiable safety constraints: every task ships `config.toml` +
  `README.md` + `VALIDATION.md`; calldata must be independently verifiable;
  simulations must pass against forked state before signing; every address is
  verified against the Superchain Registry; timelocks documented and respected.
- Author / review workflows that point to the existing canonical `docs/` guides
  rather than duplicating them.

The content was reconciled against the repo's actual structure (e.g. `src/tasks/`
and `cd src/ && just test`, not the stale paths the plugin carried), and links
to `docs/NEW_TASK_GUIDE.md`, `docs/NEW_TEMPLATE_GUIDE.md`, the SINGLE/NESTED
execution + validation docs, and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Source → destination mapping

| Source (internal plugin) | Destination |
|--------------------------|-------------|
| governance rules (task constraints, review workflow) | `AGENTS.md` → safety constraints + review sections |
| governance domain knowledge (concepts, process, safety) | `AGENTS.md` → key concepts + author task sections |
| superchain-ops repo knowledge (layout, build/test, conventions) | `AGENTS.md` → repository layout + build/test sections |

## Why `AGENTS.md` at the root

The repo had no `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `docs/ai/` directory. `AGENTS.md` is
the standard home for agent instructions and does not conflict with the existing
human-facing `docs/` tree, which it references rather than duplicates.

## Notes

- Internal tooling mechanics (skill names, internal review-agent steps, plugin
  paths) were intentionally dropped — only repo-applicable technical guidance was
  migrated.
- Draft for review; not ready to merge.

topPRs.title: chore: migrate mise aliases to tool_alias
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Replace deprecated `[alias]` with `[tool_alias]` in `mise.toml`.
- Match the Optimism monorepo Foundry alias style with `github:foundry-rs/foundry[bin=...,version_prefix=v]`.
- Bump the pinned `mise` installer to `v2026.5.18` and refresh static checksums so the documented setup path supports `[tool_alias]` and the `github:` backend.
- Bump the CircleCI utils orb from `1.0.19` to `1.0.27`, matching the Optimism monorepo setup path so CI installs a compatible `mise`.
- Keep Foundry effectively pinned to release tag `v1.1.0`.
